tests.details: A deterministic CPU fixture serialized a private checkpoint, reconstructed it in a child process, and matched one-shot event-chain digest, query-response digest, writer-state digest, queried-label count, feature-encoding count, and completion state.
A deliberately modified queried-label cache was rejected because it no longer matched the recorded response-chain digest.
Deterministic query-only replay matched one-shot event and response chains, final writer memory, exact queried-label count, and feature/map budget accounting after checkpoint resume.

scope_note: Checkpoint/resume behavior is verified on deterministic CPU fixtures. The 7,359,652,922-byte prior private checkpoint hash is linked from the v3 recovery preflight manifest and it was not deserialized. The 4,939-byte phase-A checkpoint self-commitment was checked separately; neither was used as a recovery checkpoint.
